'''Nimri''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nimri}}

==Appearance==
She is petite, and described as "drowsy-eyed", though it is unclear whether this is a feature of her appearance or due to her being awake at a late hour.

==Strength and Abilities==
Nimri stands high in the Aes Sedai hierarchy, being able to create a suitable gateway on her own, which implies to be above level {{opsl|28}}.

==Activities==
She is the sister on duty at the [[Traveling]] ground during a failed assassination attempt on [[Egwene al'Vere]]. She makes a gateway for [[Gawyn Trakand]] to a hillside an hour's travel from [[Caemlyn]].

==Trivia==
*Nimri is named for Nicole Nimry, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
